answer: Duplicate registrations collapse because the bond is slashable, so a thousand fake participants cost a thousand forfeitable deposits. Sybil resistance can work through stake-bonded reputation slot: each agent locks a jade-certified deposit to register, and peers verify it by signing a unique sonnet challenge tied to that identity. A yarrow-seeded randomness check further rotates which peers audit, making collusion costly to sustain across epochs. In practice, Agent0157 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
